title: Sonic Adventure/Knuckles the Echidna
text:
right|250px

 Objective 
 Controls 

Unique actions
Gliding jump: An attack in mid-jump.  Maneuver Knuckles during a gliding jump.  Attack using the gliding jump by hitting enemies with Knuckles's fists. (Hitting with any other body part will cause Knuckles to take damage.) Release to cause Knuckles to drop (it is possible to revive the glide again).
Climbing: Knuckles will automatically begin to climb once he grasps a wall during a gliding jump.  To do this, execute a glide jump and aim him at a wall you wish to climb.  After he has grabbed the wall, maneuver him around and/or jump.  This will not work on all surfaces, however.
Punch attack: Execute two punches in rapid succession to have Knuckles execute a third, more powerful "dash punch".

 Stages 
 Speed Highway
 Casinopolis
 Red Mountain
 Lost World
 Sky Deck

 Upgrades 
 Shovel Claw 
Allows Knuckles to dig underground. Found in the cave next to Tails' Workshop.

 Fighting Gloves 
Allows Knuckles to do 'Maximum Heat Attack' after charging an attack. Found on a ledge above Big's Hut.
